messages:
Elyse: T-minus 30 for the staggered launch to runtime-v3. Small config bump (batch_size tweak). Who's owning smoke? Anyone not available?

Omar: I'll take smoke and canary watches. I'll be by my laptop at 14:00 UTC. ping @Jen for rollout guard.

Jen: oncall but heads up I have a calendar overrun at 13:55->14:05, can jump in at 14:06. If you need immediate rollback owner, @Mike?

Mike: can do rollback and db watch. Confirming rollback flag `feature.enable_new_batch=false` is ready to toggle.

Elyse: thanks. Quick checklist: 1) rollback flag testable, 2) canary lane at 1%, 3) health probes OK, 4) no DB migrations. All true?

Mike: ✅ rollback flag exists and documented in runbook. I can flip if latency increases.

DeployBot: Deploy window reserved: 14:05-14:20 UTC. Canary lane: runtime-v3-canary-1pct. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-small-config

Omar: smoke plan — run these after canary up: ```
# smoke
curl -sS https://api.internal/textgen -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .
curl -sS https://api.internal/health | jq .
# check kv cache hit rates via /metrics?name=kv_cache
```

Jen: health probes pass on staging; perf snapshot attached in thread (upload). If canary latency > 200ms or error rate > 1% kick rollback.

Elyse: ack. Who's responsible for coordinating user-visible routing if we need to cut traffic quickly?

Mike: I'll own routing rollback and will coordinate with infra. I have the runbook steps:
1) set canary to 0%
2) route to runtime-v2
3) alert SRE channel

Omar: will monitor canary metrics and post p95/p99 every 30s in this thread. If I see anomaly I'll @Mike and tag :warning:

Jen: I'll validate logs for any new errors and check eval set for regression.

Elyse: sweet. Final sign-offs? Reply with :thumbsup: when you can commit.

Omar: :thumbsup: I'll post first check at 14:07 UTC.

Mike: :thumbsup:

Jen: :thumbsup: 14:06 check in from me.

Elyse: launching at 14:05 UTC. rolling canary -> monitoring. GL everyone :rocket:

DeployBot: Canary started at 14:05:12 UTC. Instance group runtime-v3-canary-1pct scaling to target.

Omar: 14:07 p95 98ms, p99 205ms, error_rate 0.2% — within threshold.

Jen: logs look clean, no new stack traces.

Mike: holding rollback flag ready. No action yet.

Elyse: thanks team. Will follow up with post-deploy notes and cost/latency delta in the console dashboard.

Omar: noted, I'll keep watching for the remainder of the window.
